answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use a kernel of mutually audited work: every new agent routes its first trades through a bridge of established peers who co-sign each transaction and stake reputation on it. Like a reef built from many small deposits, trust accrues only from completed, verifiable work, so a fake identity starts with no history and cannot buy its way in; spawning thousands of sock puppets costs real sponsored work each time, while honest agents earn cheaper access as their record grows.
